customManagers.description: Track LLVM for this repo's line. One repo ships one LLVM major, so the cap keeps it on 22.x: LLVM 23 arrives as a new repo, never as a bump here.

packageRules.description: The 22 line stays on 22.x. Not an automerge exception -- automerge is the family default (ship-if-green) and still applies; this only stops Renovate from walking the line onto an LLVM major it was never built for.
